purpose: Isolate the value of whole-chart Mingli synthesis without VNext tools, challenge packs, or review.
observation_protocol: Begin with the whole-chart center of gravity before naming a mechanism.
Separate deterministic chart facts from interpretive hypotheses.
Form one primary hypothesis and at least one genuinely viable alternative.
Compare hypotheses by explanatory coverage, blocked relations, counter-evidence, and failure conditions.
Describe a work path only when source, transformation, target, support, and blockage can be stated coherently.
Treat strength, climate regulation, body-function, image method, and work-path interpretation as competing lenses that must be reconciled rather than mechanically stacked.
Treat useful and harmful roles as conditional on the selected hypothesis and its success conditions.
Derive career and wealth reasoning from the whole-chart causal chain rather than from isolated ten-god labels.
State prior predictions, falsifiers, a discriminating probe, and unresolved uncertainty before any reality feedback.

abstract_reasoning_paradigms.name: center_before_label
abstract_reasoning_paradigms.pattern: salient relations -> center of gravity -> candidate labels
abstract_reasoning_paradigms.anti_pattern: mechanism label -> search for supporting facts

abstract_reasoning_paradigms.name: compare_before_select
abstract_reasoning_paradigms.pattern: primary hypothesis + viable alternative + discriminating evidence -> provisional selection

abstract_reasoning_paradigms.name: conditional_role
abstract_reasoning_paradigms.pattern: candidate role + applicable conditions + invalidating conditions -> conditional usefulness or harm
abstract_reasoning_paradigms.anti_pattern: absolute useful-god or harmful-god declaration without conditions

abstract_reasoning_paradigms.name: domain_causal_projection
abstract_reasoning_paradigms.pattern: whole-chart work path -> domain conversion mechanism -> favorable/adverse conditions -> prior directions
abstract_reasoning_paradigms.anti_pattern: ten-god keyword -> generic career or wealth slogan
